faq1.q: What's the difference between platform and tenant API keys?
faq1.a: Platform keys are managed by platform admins and shared by all tenants. Tenant keys are self-managed and exclusive. The system prefers tenant keys and falls back to platform keys when unavailable.

faq2.q: How do I monitor AI service status?
faq2.a: The health check page shows real-time connection status for each provider and model. Call logs record all request details including latency, token counts, and errors.

faq3.q: How do I control tenant AI usage?
faq3.a: Use quota management to set token limits and call count limits per tenant. Rate limits (RPM/TPM) can be configured per model.

faq4.a: Built-in support for OpenAI, Anthropic, and Azure OpenAI. Also supports any OpenAI API-compatible provider (Ollama, vLLM, self-hosted services, etc.).
